title_zh: 约定修正虚构案件摘要中的定罪状态

scenario.label_zh: 约定修正虚构案件摘要中的定罪状态
scenario.goal_zh: 区分羁押与定罪，并依给定记录保留尚无判决结果的状态

context_zh: 新闻写作课堂使用虚构案件资料。材料包含证据描述，并说明嫌疑人仍被羁押、审判尚未开始；课堂重点是区分这些信息与有罪判决。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Dara
sentences.text: The case sheet says the suspect remains in custody. Can I write that there has been a conviction?

sentences.speaker: Tutor
sentences.text: No. In this exercise, the trial has not begun. The sheet does not say a court has found the person guilty.

sentences.speaker: Dara
sentences.text: But the evidence section sounds very serious.

sentences.speaker: Tutor
sentences.text: That is not enough for us to write that a court will convict the suspect. Our summary must reflect the recorded status.

sentences.speaker: Dara
sentences.text: Then I'll remove the sentence about a conviction and say that the suspect is in custody awaiting trial.

sentences.speaker: Tutor
sentences.text: Yes. Keep that distinction clear and do not predict the result.
